correctness.rationale: The finite graph, all 2,598 augmented faces, exact nine mod-two boundary ranks, and all 216 automorphisms are exhaustively enumerated. Rational homology concentration follows by universal coefficients; Euler characteristic gives ten fourth-homology dimensions. Signed Lefschetz traces agree by direct fixed oriented faces and by independent vertex-cycle quotient graphs. For two integer-valued 13-class candidates of degrees 4 and 6, exact center-algebra multiplication for every class pair certifies genuine irreducibles, their sum equals the homology trace, and rational multiplicity one gives descent. The quotient follows by characteristic-zero averaging.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical rank-three Levi graph with 216 automorphisms. Classifying its complete ten-dimensional homology representation as two distinct irreducibles, and finding the rational homology of its full symmetry quotient, gives natural algebraic-topological invariants not determined by the earlier nonequivariant Betti number or one C3 subgroup character. The 13-class classification has intrinsic utility in equivariant topological comparisons and is not an arbitrary small numerical slice.
